teams.detail: Playing the rubber match against Toronto this afternoon at T-Mobile Park — Emerson Hancock (5-4, 3.47 ERA) vs. Trey Yesavage (4-3, 3.34 ERA) — after Saturday's 11-0 rout keyed by Randy Arozarena's grand slam and a Logan Gilbert one-hitter into the 8th. Mariners sit 46-44, 2nd in the AL West; today's result was still pending as of this brief.

Summer League roster is set: No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie (Stanford) headlines a group with 2nd-rounder Ugonna Onyenso and Roddy Gayle Jr. Vegas slate opens July 9 vs. 76ers, then Cavaliers (7/12), Knicks (7/13) and Suns (7/15).

Reigning Super Bowl LX champs enter 2026 on a 10-game winning streak (290-145 point differential). Front office promoted Matt Berry and Willie Schneider to assistant GM; training camp opens July 25 in Renton, with the team and WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba both ESPY nominees (July 15).

RB Jordan Washington (spring injury) still targeting a late-July return; WR Justice Williams is emerging as a potential No. 3 option behind Dezmen Roebuck and Rashid Williams. Coach Jedd Fisch says the Huskies have the physicality to compete over a full Big Ten season.

F Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle continues rebuilding via the portal after losing Zoom Diallo, with 2026 signee Lattimore Ford and several transfers filling out next year's roster.

headlines.headline: LeBron James tells Lakers he's leaving as Cavaliers emerge as frontrunner
headlines.detail: Rich Paul fielding interest from Cleveland, Miami, Denver, Minnesota and Philadelphia; Lakers send Deandre Ayton to Washington for Jaden Hardy and two second-rounders.

headlines.headline: Travis Kelce marries Taylor Swift as NFL enters quiet stretch before camp
headlines.detail: League also finalized a settlement with QB Brendan Sorsby preserving his 2027 draft eligibility; most teams report to camp later this month.

headlines.headline: Transfer portal window closes: Texas Tech lands Sorsby, Penn State imports Iowa State's offense
headlines.detail: Penn State's new staff brought QB Rocco Becht and nearly two dozen players from Iowa State; LSU (Kiffin) and Indiana (Cignetti) also among the most active.

headlines.headline: NCAA tournament set to expand to 76 teams as realigned Pac-12 kicks off play
headlines.detail: Five Mountain West programs, Gonzaga and Texas State officially joined the rebuilt nine-team Pac-12 on July 1; Gonzaga projected No. 6 nationally.
